parole.significato: A small wild cat of Central Asia, Otocolobus manul.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian ману́л (manúl), from Mongolian мануул (manuul)/ᠮᠠᠨᠤᠤᠯ (manuul).

parole.significato: The Mongolian unit of currency; abbreviated MNT, ₮; formerly subdivided into 100 möngö.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian ту́грик (túgrik), from Mongolian ᠲᠥᠭᠥᠷᠢᠭ (tögörig), a semantic loan of Chinese 圓 /圆 (yuán, “circle, round; dollar, silver coin; yuan”).
